news.analysis: Williams has been impactful behind center of late, passing for two touchdowns in four of his last five games. The quarterback offers fantasy managers a dynamic QB1 option ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.contents: Caleb Williams completed 30-of-44 pass attempts for 345 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing three times for 15 yards in the Bears' 39-35 Week 12 win over the Lions.
news.title: Caleb Williams comes up clutch in Week 12 win over Lions

news.analysis: Watson continues a reliable stretch in the Green Bay offense, finishing with 50 or more receiving yards in six of his last seven games. The wideout remains one of the few dynamic pass-catching options as part of an inconsistent Green Bay offense that will look to take advantage of an extended break to clear through concussion protocols ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the New Orleans Saints.
news.contents: Christian Watson (concussion) hauled in all four of his targets for 65 yards and one touchdown in the Packers' 26-13 Week 12 loss to the Rams.
news.title: Christian Watson (concussion) lone bright spot before exiting in Week 12

news.analysis: Burden III has offered mixed results in the Chicago offense of late, recording less than 90 receiving yards in three of his last six contests. The wideout continues to flash explosive potential in the Chicago offense ahead of a Week 13 matchup against the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.contents: Luther Burden III hauled in three of his seven targets for 44 yards while also rushing once for one yard in the Bears' 39-35 win over the Lions in Week 12.
news.title: Luther Burden III sees four touches in Week 12 win

news.analysis: Kincaid will take the field after logging limited practice activity on a short week, offering quarterback Josh Allen another impactful pass-catching option against the Chiefs Thanksgiving night.
news.contents: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is active for Week 12 for the Buffalo Bills against the Kansas City Chiefs according to Adam Schefter.
news.title: Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle) active for Week 12

news.analysis: Aubrey continues a productive stretch behind a high-powered Dallas offense, recording eight or more points in each of his last six contests. The kicker remains one of the more impactful options entering a tough Week 13 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.
news.contents: Brandon Aubrey converted all five of his extra point attempts as well as one of his two field goal attempts to finish with eight points in the Cowboys' 39-38 loss to the Eagles in Week 12.
news.title: Brandon Aubrey misses field goal in Week 12

news.analysis: Greenlaw was limited in practice on Thursday. He appears to be trending in the right direction.
news.contents: Dre Greenlaw is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
news.title: Dre Greenlaw (neck) listed questionable for Week 12

news.analysis: Walker has practiced this week, but he will not be ready to go for Thursday's game. Emmett Johnson will once again shoulder the load out of the Chiefs' backfield. Walker should have a good shot at returning in Week 13.
news.contents: Kenneth Walker III (groin) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Bills.
news.title: Kenneth Walker III (groin) will not play Thursday

news.analysis: Lloyd has been dismal out of the backfield to this point, finishing with less than 40 offensive yards in each of his 10 games. The running back is best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 13 contest against the New Orleans Saints.
news.contents: MarShawn Lloyd rushed once for 10 yards while also catching his only target for six yards in the Packers' 26-13 Week 12 loss to the Rams.
